annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee: Regulatory simplification – The use of digital tools in better law-making (Exploratory opinion requested by the Danish Presidency)
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee: Regulatory simplification – The use of digital tools in better law-making
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: EESC exploratory opinion, requested by the Danish Presidency, on using AI and digital tools in EU law-making. It recommends a unified interoperable law-making platform, a database of summarised legal obligations, and a regtech chief. It stresses human-centred use, with AI supporting rather than replacing democratic processes and stakeholder dialogue.
key_provisions_or_claims: Create a unified, interoperable digital platform for EU law-making via an updated interinstitutional agreement.
Set up a centralised database of atomised legal obligations as structured XML data.
Nominate a regtech chief to introduce digital tools and AI in EU regulatory processes.
Use tested AI to find overlaps, gaps and stakeholder sentiment, but not to replace social dialogue.
Attach human-translated summaries of obligations to each legal act.
